title: SpongeBob Cosmic Jam
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands on a paint-splattered purple table, pointing forward with a wide smile inside a swirling cosmic portal. In a dilapidated art studio with dripping purple slime on the walls and ceiling, a band of three musicians plays instruments while a large purple octopus and several ghosts float nearby.
prompt: SpongeBob SquarePants stands triumphantly on a purple wooden table in the center of a decaying art studio, pointing forward with a big smile. He emerges from a swirling cosmic vortex portal filled with stars and nebulae. A giant purple octopus with many tentacles floats to the right. In the foreground, a long-haired band plays music: one person on saxophone, one on drums, and one on electric guitar. The wooden studio has peeling walls covered in dripping purple, pink, and green slime from the ceiling. Several translucent ghosts float around the band. The floor is covered in colorful paint splatters. Dramatic light rays shine from above.
